pr_title: [fix] 1.@html in template set inner html, 2. with sibling error closes [#7315, #7319]
pr_body:
extending and dependent on this unmerged PR 
- #7297 

closes: 
 - #7315
 - #7319


note that this fixes both mentioned open issues.  

With **ssr+hydration** being an edge case. 
Sibling elements to the `{@html}` render in the reverse/incorrect order. 
unlikely related to the changes of this PR, and more so to pre existing issues with ssr hydration logic 
involving `{@html}`
